description: Adjusted RR of speeding exposures within strata, with design-based heterogeneity tests (ratio of the two strata RRs)
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with a determinable NHTSA-imputed maximum severity (MAXSEV_IM 0-4)
method: Model A blocks minus the blocks that define the stratum, fitted within stratum; standardised over stratum crashes
